name: No ABC policy
description: No documented anti-bribery / anti-corruption policy and code of conduct.

name: No staff / officer ABC training
description: Staff and officers untrained on ABC red flags, gifts policy, escalation.

name: No conflict-of-interest disclosure
description: Staff and officers do not periodically disclose conflicts of interest.

name: No procurement segregation / approvals
description: Same individual selects, contracts and approves payment to suppliers.

name: No third-party agent due diligence
description: Agents and intermediaries onboarded without ABC due diligence.

name: No controls on agent payment patterns
description: Agent fees not benchmarked; no approval workflow for unusual payments.

name: No gifts / hospitality register
description: No register of gifts and hospitality given or received.
